title: Main attach port adoption, terminal/detach succession and bounded fault support
statement: Three communication outcomes are consumed end to end on main's real sources: the optional AttachedAttemptPort plus attachRunnerAttempt caller over the real Store ingress/payload/guard; temporary detach, terminal close and business succession across two real callers; and bounded pressure, typed diagnostics and four-endpoint isolation. The channel module itself is unchanged (already in main). Original Application/QuestionBroker Work recovery, SIGKILL and product slot release remain NOT_REACHED.

outcomes.title: Actual main three callbacks and typed compatibility adopted
outcomes.implementation: main optional AttachedAttemptPort (data only) + attachRunnerAttempt caller; I module unchanged
outcomes.positive: payload callback receives the original reference and returns the original JSON body; fact receipt equals the real ProductStore row seq; one guard call per intent and a fresh nonce
outcomes.negative: foreign producer refused at bind; deny and missing guard both zero writes; no fabricated receipt/body
outcomes.notReached: original Application-created Work / QuestionBroker question-answer delivery

outcomes.title: Temporary detach, terminal and original-business succession
outcomes.implementation: two real callers over the same endpoint/generation CAS; main terminal close
outcomes.positive: successor continues the same attempt and original fact ids reach the Store; fresh intent needs and gets its own decision
outcomes.negative: pending native intent is indeterminate with zero served writes; old approval cannot settle; terminal fails a pending callback closed and refuses a late/new caller
outcomes.notReached: same original Work recovered to check/currentCandidate/manualaccept (B/main)

outcomes.title: Bounded pressure, diagnostics and multi-slot handoff
outcomes.implementation: real caller + real service bounds; four endpoint pairs
outcomes.positive: slow-Store burst drains within deadline; 64-fact bound admits 64 and drains; four slots keep their own decisions
outcomes.negative: 65th fact refused as capacity; callback failure is a typed ack-failure; terminal channels refuse a new caller
outcomes.notReached: product scheduler 2/4 slots, fifth-item waiting, aggregate slot release and full resource barrier (B/main)

checks.note: restored after reverting an additive error-field change that altered main's observed denial string

artifacts.note: No tar/ZIP created or certified here; D freezes and E verifies the same bytes independently.

corrections: An additive `NativeWriteDenied.code` field was tried and reverted: it changed main's observed denial string from 'refused' to 'native_write_denied' and broke tests/integration/attached-port.case.mjs (2/4). The error shape stays unchanged; consumers use instanceof or toAttachFailure.
remaining: original Application/QuestionBroker Work question-answer and native_applied/ACK-unknown reconciliation (B/main)
same-Work recovered check/currentCandidate/manualaccept and product 2/4 slot release (B/main)
same-Runner coordinator SIGKILL successor (not run; no unsafe tools)
real vendor/model/native turns (0) and installed/native facts
